{{Quote|I am Emtrey, human-cyborg relations and regulations with a military specialty. I am fluent in over six million languages and familiar with an equivalent number of current and historical military doctrines, regulations, honor codes, and protocols.|M-3PO|<ref name="Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>}}
[[File:M-3PO_EGD.jpg|thumb|right|200px|An M-3PO military protocol droid]]
'''Military protocol droids''',<ref name="Rogue Squadron" /> also known as '''protocol and regulations droids''',<ref name="Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> were a subclass of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] designed for military applications.<ref name="M-3PO">{{CSWECite|II|271|M-3PO}}</ref> Though classified as [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]]s,<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> they were also categorized as [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="Standoffs">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041216|text=Standoffs}}</ref>

Manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]], the [[M-3PO military protocol droid]], a variant of the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]], was an example of such a [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" />

[[IMP-22]] was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military protocol droid programmed in [[Politics/Legends|politics]] and warfare, which made it a valuable [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|85|IMP-22}}</ref> The military protocol droid [[M-3PO (Emtrey)/Legends|M-3PO]] served as the [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron" />
